decisions.reason: Defines paste_image/paste_file with smallest-free (2)(3) before the extension, explicit origin gate in add() applied before validateItems/records.set/insertReference, batch planning plus synchronous in-flight reservations, drop/picker/unknown origins keep verbatim names.

Names the live composer snapshot occurrences as the authoritative taken-name source and explains the records subscription deletes entries on any momentary empty/partial snapshot while the attachment remains live; covers batch names and in-flight reservations; records may only render, never decide.

Cites x-cache HIT, age 178, s-maxage and the stale v0.2.9-max payload, plus renderCurrentChip printing the fetched tag; rule: update chip only when remote > running, current chip shows running, remote < running is stale/unconfirmed never 'already latest'.

A1/A6 cover repeated and same-batch pastes with distinct names; A2 shows allocation stays correct with an emptied records cache; A3 pins unchanged drop/picker names; B1-B3 replay the older captured tag, equal, and newer tags with concrete assertions.

Syncs PLUGIN_VERSION with package.json (plus tarball/tag equality gate), adds node --check parse gates and behavioral suites, and explains deployment via install/publish, host restart (bundles cached at boot) and page reload/hard refresh; chip is advisory only, no host-side update endpoint.
